blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Vegetation plays a central role in cities, serving functional roles such as balancing shade and sky exposure, shaping the microclimate, carbon sequestration, and providing acoustic screening. Furthermore, aesthetic choices in landscape styles (formal, modernist, picturesque) are important for citizens' well-being and should be considered in the design of urban landscapes. In this paper, we present a novel method for placing vegetation, ranging from shrubs to large trees, in 3D urban scenes. Our method uses individual lots as input and employs a conditioned Vision-Language Model (VLM) to generate a top-down rendering of vegetation, placing large trees, small trees, and shrubs on lawn areas. This rendering is then converted into a 3D scene by detecting individual plants and selecting appropriate 3D assets. To refine the proposed configurations, we define an optimization loop that keeps the VLM-generated positions fixed after a deterministic feasibility repair and uses CMA-ES to optimize per-instance scale transformations along with discrete vegetation asset substitutions. To define the objective function for the optimization, we evaluate the generated 3D scenes with efficient surrogate models of shade and path-based acoustic exposure. Furthermore, we render in-scene views at each optimization step to compute view-dependent perceptual descriptors, enabling the generation of both aesthetic and functional vegetation layouts for urban scenes.
blocks.zh: 植被在城市中起中心作用,发挥平衡遮荫和天空照射等功能作用,塑造微观气候,固碳,提供声学筛选. 此外,景观风格的审美选择(正规的、现代的、平面的)对于公民的福祉很重要,在设计城市景观时应予以考虑。 在本文中,我们提出了一种将从灌木到大树的植被放入3D城市场景的新颖方法. 我们的方法使用单个地块作为输入,并使用有条件的VLM-Langage Model(VLM)生成自上而下地渲染出植被,将大树,小树和灌木放入草地地区. 然后通过探测单个植物并选择适当的3D资产,将这种渲染转化为3D场景. 为了完善提议的配置,我们界定了一个优化循环,使VLM产生的位置在确定可行性修复后保持固定,并使用CMA-ES来优化每层规模的转换以及离散植被资产替代。 为了定义优化的客观功能,我们用高效的代位模型来评价所生成的3D场景的阴影和基于路径的相声曝光. 此外,我们在每个优化步骤上都提出场景,以计算视线依赖的能见度描述符,从而能够为城市场景提供美学和功能性植被布局。

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 导言

blocks.en: Synthesizing urban vegetation in computer graphics poses substantial challenges due to the interplay of planning constraints, aesthetic composition across multiple scales, from individual plants to city-wide ecosystems, and vegetation diversity. Modeling urban landscapes is critical for visual storytelling in games and movies ( Smelik et al., 2014 ) , urban planning ( Vanegas et al., 2012 ) , microclimate analysis ( Toparlar et al., 2017 ) , and digital twins ( Ketzler et al., 2020 ) . Moreover, urban afforestation plays a critical role in making cities more livable ( European Parliament and the Council of the European Union, 2024 ; European Commission, 2021 ) .
blocks.zh: 在计算机图形中合成城市植被,由于规划限制的相互作用、从单个植物到整个城市的生态系统的多尺度审美组成以及植被多样性,都带来了重大挑战。 模拟城市地貌对于游戏和电影中的视觉故事讲述(Smelik等,2014年),城市规划(Vanegas等,2012年),微观气候分析(Toparlar等,2017年),和数字双胞胎(Ketzler等,2020年)至关重要. 此外,城市植树造林在使城市更适合居住方面发挥着关键作用(欧洲议会和欧洲联盟理事会,2024;欧洲联盟委员会,2021)。

blocks.en: While computer graphics has made significant progress in procedural city generation and building synthesis ( Parish and Müller, 2001 ; Müller et al., 2006 ; Nishida et al., 2016 ) , most existing techniques either reduce vegetation to stochastic point distributions or focus solely on trees, ignoring the understory, shrubbery, and ground cover. Ecosystem simulations provide high-fidelity growth models but are designed for wild, competitive environments ( Pałubicki et al., 2022 ; Peytavie et al., 2024 ; Gain et al., 2017 ; Emilien et al., 2015 ) and not for managed urban spaces ( Benes et al., 2011 ) . Others focus on learning distributions from satellite data ( Niese et al., 2022 ) , but often lack the precise controllability required to enforce specific setbacks, clearance zones, or functional performance goals. Generative approaches have begun to explore text-to-3D city synthesis ( Xie et al., 2024 ; Feng et al., 2023 ) and reconstruction ( Liu et al., 2025b ; Zhang et al., 2020 ) . However, coupling explicit landscape design rules with quantifiable 3D performance metrics, such as acoustic damping or thermal comfort, remains largely unaddressed.
blocks.zh: 虽然计算机图形在程序城市生成和建筑合成方面取得了显著进展(Parish and Müller,2001;Müller等人,2006;Nishida等人,2016),但大多数现有技术要么将植被减少为花点分布,要么只关注树木,而忽略了底物,灌木和地表覆盖. 生态系统模拟提供了高纯度生长模型,但针对的是野生和竞争性环境(Pawubicki等,2022年;Peytavie等,2024年;Gain等,2017年;Emilien等,2015年),而不是为管理下的城市空间(Benes等,2011年)。 另一些则侧重于从卫星数据中学习分布(Niese等人,2022年),但往往缺乏执行具体的挫折、清除区或功能性能目标所需的精确可控性。 已着手探讨文本至3D城市合成(谢等,2024;冯等,2023)和重建(刘等,2025b; 张等, 2020. ). 然而,将明确的地貌设计规则与可量化的三维性能衡量标准相配合,例如声道坝或热舒适度,基本上仍未得到解决。

blocks.en: We present a novel urban landscaping framework for synthesizing heterogeneous vegetation assets. For a given urban layout, our method employs a design-centric approach to generating and optimizing vegetation layout and function. The input is a 2D map of the urban layout and a text prompt describing the layout strategy. Our framework outputs aesthetically plausible vegetation configuration that fulfills high-order functional constraints. We show that modeling urban landscapes can be accomplished by coupling Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for high-level semantic structure with evolutionary optimization (CMA-ES) ( Hansen and Ostermeier, 2001 ) for geometric refinement. This enables the generation of a broad range of design typologies, such as borders, allées, and garden rooms, while adhering to parcel geometry. Unlike previous models that focus on vegetation location, our framework explicitly evaluates functional performance by estimating shade coverage, sky-view factors (SVF), and acoustic attenuation. Fig. 1 shows three park designs generated from identical geometric site constraints. Left: a formal layout with regular spacing. Center: a picturesque, asymmetric composition with clustered planting. Right: a modernist scheme characterized by clear, rigorous geometry.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了一个新的城市景观框架,以综合各种植被资产。 对于特定的城市布局,我们的方法采用以设计为中心的方法来产生和优化植被布局和功能. 输入是城市布局的2D地图和描述布局策略的文字提示. 我们的框架在美学上提供了合理的植被配置,满足了高序功能限制。 我们显示,通过将高级语义结构的VLM(VLMs)与进化优化(CMA-ES)(Hansen and Ostermeier, 2001.)相配合来进行几何改进,可以实现城市地貌的模型化. 这使得可以生成一系列广泛的设计类型,如边框,Allees和花园房间,同时坚持包裹几何. 与以往侧重于植被位置的模型不同,我们的框架通过估计遮荫覆盖、天景因子(SVF)和声衰减来明确评价功能性能。 图一显示三个公园设计是由相同的几何地点限制产生的. 左:有正间距的正式布局. 中心:以组装栽培为主的相克,不对称成分. 右:以清晰,严谨几何为特征的现代主义方案.

blocks.en: Our contributions are (1) a hybrid landscaping framework combining VLM-based structural priors with geometric evolutionary optimization, (2) phenomenological functional objectives – efficient scene-design surrogates for shade, biomass, and acoustic exposure – and (3) a coupled evaluation scheme for view-dependent aesthetics. Source code, prompt templates, and configurations are publicly available at https://github.com/greenscapes-project/greenscapes .
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献是:(1) 混合景观美化框架,将基于VLM的结构前科与几何进化优化相结合;(2) phenomenological功能目标 — — 高效的场景设计替代遮荫、生物质和声波曝光 — — 以及(3) 依赖观光美学的结合评价计划。 在https://github.com/greenscapes-project/greenscapes上可公开查阅源代码、即时模板和配置。

blocks.en: 2. Related Work
blocks.zh: 2. 相关工作

blocks.en: Computer graphics research on plant synthesis spans procedural modeling, reconstruction, and interactive authoring.
blocks.zh: 有关植物合成的计算机图形学研究跨越了程序建模,重建,以及交互式的作者.

blocks.en: Early approaches model branching using rule-based systems ( Honda, 1971 ) , grammars ( Aono and Kunii, 1984 ) , particle systems ( Reeves and Blau, 1985 ) , and fractals ( Oppenheimer, 1986 ) . L-systems ( Prusinkiewicz, 1986 ; Prusinkiewicz and Lindenmayer, 1990 ; Pałubicki et al., 2019 ) provide a principled formalism for plant generation. However, specifying rules for complex trees is labor-intensive and may require learned rule inference ( Guo et al., 2020 ; Lee et al., 2023 ) . To improve usability, procedural modeling methods combine botanical priors with geometric modeling and interactive controls ( Weber and Penn, 1995 ; Lintermann and Deussen, 1996 ; Longay et al., 2012 ) . Subsequent work addresses self-organizing growth ( Palubicki et al., 2009 ; Runions et al., 2005 ; Guo et al., 2020 ) , inverse procedural modeling ( Stava et al., 2014 ) , urban forests ( Niese et al., 2022 ; Benes et al., 2011 ) , and environmental response ( Pirk et al., 2012 ) .
blocks.zh: 早期方法模型分枝使用规则系统(本田,1971年),语法(Aono和Kunii,1984年),粒子系统(Reeves和Brau,1985年),分形(Oppenheimer,1986年). L系统 (Prusankiewicz,1986;Prusankiewicz and Lindenmayer,1990;Pauhubicki等,2019)为植物的产生提供了原则性形式主义. 然而,为复杂树木具体规定规则是劳动密集型的,可能需要学习规则推论(Guo等,2020;Lee等,2023)。 为了提高可用性,程序模型方法将植物学前科与几何模型和交互控制相结合(Weber和Penn,1995年;Lintermann和Deussen,1996年;Longay等,2012年)。 随后的工作涉及自我组织增长(Palubicki等,2009年;Runions等,2005年;Guo等,2020年),逆向程序模型(Stava等,2014年),城市森林 (Niese等人,2022年;Benes等人,2011年),以及环境反应(Pirk等人,2012年).

blocks.en: Tree reconstruction has been studied from single or multi-view imagery ( Neubert et al., 2007 ; Tan et al., 2008 ; Reche-Martinez et al., 2004 ) , point clouds ( Xu et al., 2007 ; Livny et al., 2011 ) , and videos ( Li et al., 2011 ) . Several pipelines leverage intermediate representations, such as segmentation masks ( Argudo et al., 2016 ) or 3D bounding volumes ( Li et al., 2021 ) , to regularize inference of branching and foliage. Bradley et al. (2013) reconstruct dense foliage by combining stereo-derived point clouds with a statistical model.
blocks.zh: 已经从单一或多视图图像中研究了树木重建(Neubert等,2007年;Tan等,2008年;Reche-Martinez等,2004年),点云 (徐等,2007;李夫尼等,2011),和视频 (李等,2011. 多条管线利用分块口罩等中间表示(Argudo等,2016年)或3D绑定体积(Li等,2021年)来规范分块和叶片的推断. Bradley等(2013年)通过将立体衍生出点云与统计模型相融合来重建密集叶片.

blocks.en: Interactive authoring aims to make plant design practical for artists and designers. Sketch-based methods use gestures and silhouettes that guide procedural branching ( Okabe et al., 2007 ; Tan et al., 2008 ; Chen et al., 2008 ) , as well as sketch-driven modeling of plants ( Anastacio et al., 2009 ) and flowers ( Ijiri et al., 2006 ) . TreeSketch provides a particularly complete integration of user sketches with procedural generation ( Longay et al., 2012 ) .
blocks.zh: 互动作者旨在让工厂设计对艺术家和设计师实用. Sketch基方法使用手势和 silhoettes来指导程序分支(Okabe等,2007年;Tan等,2008年;Chen等,2008年),以及草图驱动的植物建模(Anastacio等,2009年)和花卉(Ijiri等,2006年). TreeSketch提供了用户草图与程序生成特别完整的集成(Longay等,2012.).

blocks.en: Figure 2 . Overview of our pipeline for prompt-driven park vegetation design. Inputs are a user text prompt (a) and OSM-derived site context (b). An image-to-image constrained editor generates multiple top-down layout proposals (c), which are converted to a metric top-down representation (d) and processed by instance extraction (e) to obtain candidate pedestrian viewpoints (f) and vegetation instance positions and coarse types (g). These instances are projected into world coordinates and assembled into a 3D park scene (h). We evaluate candidate scenes by rendering multiple in-scene views to compute perceptual descriptors and biomass-related quantities (i) and by running physics-inspired field models for functional measures such as shade and sound (j). CMA-ES then refines continuous instance parameters and triggers discrete species substitutions under a Gaussian-mixture asset prior using the combined perceptual and functional objectives (k), yielding the final optimized park layout (l).
blocks.zh: 图2 我国快速推进公园植被设计管线概况. 输入是一个用户文本提示(a)和OSM出处上下文(b). 图像到图像受限编辑器生成多条自上而下布局建议(c),这些提议被转换为自上而下的指标(d)并按实例提取(e)处理,以获得候选行人观点(f)和植被实例位置及粗糙类型(g)。 这些情况被投射到世界坐标并被组装成3D公园场景(h). 我们评价候选场景,方法是提供多场场景,以计算知觉描述符和与生物质有关的量(一),并运行物理启发的场模型,用于诸如阴影和声音(j)等功能测量. CMA-ES随后完善了连续实例参数并触发了高斯-混合资产下的离散物种替代,然后使用综合认知和功能目标(k),从而产生最终优化的公园布局(l)。

blocks.en: Recent generative pipelines have begun to address text- and structure-conditioned synthesis of large outdoor environments by combining layout planning from language and diffusion-based generation of scene representations. On the layout side, LLM and VLM-driven planners generate structured spatial specifications (e.g., bounding boxes, scene elements, or hierarchical layouts) that can be executed by downstream generators, enabling improved controllability and spatial reasoning compared to direct text-to-image generation ( Feng et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2025 ; Srivastava et al., 2025 ) . For outdoor and urban environments, diffusion models have been extended from object- and indoor-centric settings toward city-scale or real-world outdoor scene synthesis, including semantic scene generation and editing in large outdoor maps ( Lee et al., 2024 ) , text-driven multi-view consistent 3D scene generation that supports long camera trajectories and outdoor content ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) , and coarse-to-fine 3D diffusion schemes designed for detailed large-scale outdoor scenes ( Liu et al., 2024a ) . Structure-conditioned urban generation has explored graph-based formulations, including hierarchical layout generation at the city scale from scene-graph-conditioned diffusion for controllable 3D outdoor scenes ( Liu et al., 2025a ) . LLM-assisted procedural modeling has also been explored for instruction-driven 3D asset construction in 3D-GPT ( Sun et al., 2025 ) , text-controlled procedural landscape generation ( Liu et al., 2024b ) , and large-scale procedural scene generation in SceneX ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) . While these methods substantially improve controllability, they primarily optimize for visual or structural fidelity. In contrast, our approach explicitly couples generative proposals with functional and perceptual evaluation inside an optimization loop.
blocks.zh: 近期的基因管道开始通过将布局规划从语言和以传播为基础的场景表现方式结合起来,解决以文字和结构为条件的大型室外环境合成问题. 在布局方面,由LLM和VLM驱动的规划者生成结构化的空间规格(例如,边框,场景元素,或分级布局),可以由下游发电机执行,与直接的文本到图像生成相比,能够提高可控性和空间推理(Feng等,2023;Wang等,2025;Srivastava等,2025.). 就户外和城市环境而言,传播模型已从以物体和室内为中心的环境扩展到城市规模或现实世界的户外场景合成,包括用大型户外地图制作和编辑语义场景(Lee等,2024年),以文字驱动的多视图一致的3D场景生成,支持长相机轨迹和户外内容(Zhang等,2024年),以及为详细大型户外场景而设计的粗到细的3D传播方案(Liu等,2024年a年) 。 。 。 。 结构有条件的城市一代探索了以图为主的配方,包括从场景图为可控的3D室外场景而作的以图为主的分级布局生成(Liu等,2025a) 。 。 。 。 在3D-GPT(Sun等,2025年),文本控制程序景观生成(Liu等,2024年b),以及SceeneX(周等,2025年)的大规模程序场景生成方面,LLM辅助程序模型也进行了探索. 虽然这些方法大大提高了可控性,但主要是优化视觉或结构上的忠诚。 与此相反,我们的方法明确结合了基因建议,在优化循环中进行功能和知觉评价。

blocks.en: 3. Method
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en:
The inputs to our pipeline (Fig. 2 ) are a user-defined text prompt (Fig. 2 a) and a lot polygon geometry from OpenStreetMap (OSM) ( Haklay and Weber, 2008 ) data expressed in a 2D coordinate frame (Fig. 2 b). We rasterize the OSM polygon into a top-down conditioning image
and run a constrained image-to-image generator (Gemini 3, ( Google DeepMind, 2025 ) ) instructed to modify only a designated editable region (grass). This produces top-down vegetation-layout proposals (Fig. 2 c) that are used as the sole input for class-wise instance extraction (Fig. 2 d–e). All experiments use fixed prompt templates rather than interactively tuned prompts. The templates specify the editable mask, the allowed vegetation vocabulary, the required top-down orthographic style, and the requested landscape pattern or design strategy. In our experiments, we used 18 fixed templates: 17 style and layout templates for prompt-conditioned generation and one annotation template for instance extraction. In parallel, we construct a bounded set of evaluation viewpoints by prompting the VLM to annotate pedestrian standing points and view directions on the conditioning raster (Fig. 2 f); the decoding procedure is detailed in the supplementary material. Detected instances are then projected into world coordinates, assigned assets from a library, and assembled into a 3D scene with per-instance attribute vectors and collision proxies (Fig. 2 g–h). We evaluate candidate scenes by rendering in-scene buffers from the selected viewpoints and compute image- and simulation-derived metrics (Fig. 2 i–j). Finally, we refine continuous per-instance parameters and discrete asset identities using the Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy (CMA-ES) under a low-dimensional parameterization coupled with a Gaussian Mixture Model (GMM) (Fig. 2 k). We return the best feasible configuration (Fig. 2 l).

我们的管道输入(图2)是一个用户自定义的文本提示(图2 a)和来自OpenStreetMap(OSM)(Haklay和Weber,2008年)的许多多边形几何数据以2D坐标框架(图2 b)表示. 我们把OSM多边形画成一个自上而下配置的图像
并运行受限的图像到图像生成器(Gemini 3, (Google DeepMind, 2025)),指令只修改指定的可编辑区域(grass). 这产生了自上而下地铺放植被的提议(图2c),这些提议是按等级进行采掘的唯一投入(图2d-e)。 所有实验使用固定的即时模板,而不是交互调制的即时. 模板指定了可编辑的口罩,允许的植被词汇,需要自上而下地平面样式,以及要求的地貌图案或设计策略. 在我们的实验中,我们使用了18个固定模板:17个样式和布局模板用于快速有条件的生成,以及一个注释模板,例如提取. 与此同时,我们通过引导甚高频标注行人立站点和在起发光栅上取景方向(图2f),构建一套有限度的评价观点;补充材料详细介绍了解码程序。 检测到的情况随后被投射到世界坐标,从一个库中分配资产,并组装成带有每层属性向量和相撞代理的三维场景(图2克-小时)。 我们通过从所选角度渲染内幕缓冲以及计算图像和模拟衍生的度量衡(图2 i-j)来评价候选场景。 最后,我们利用Covariance矩阵适应演变战略(CMA-ES),在低维参数化下,加上高斯混合模型(GMM)(图2 k),完善连续的每层参数和离散资产身份. 我们返回最佳可行的配置(图2一)。

blocks.en: 3.1. OSM Preprocessing, Masks, and Assets
blocks.zh: 3.1. OSM 预处理、面罩和资产

blocks.en: For the target lot and neighborhood context, we query OSM for polygonal geometry (lot boundaries, building footprints, and obstacles) and graph geometry (streets and paths).
blocks.zh: 对于目标地块和邻里环境,我们查询OSM的多边形几何(地块边界,建出脚印和障碍物)和图表几何(地块和路径).

blocks.en: The OSM tags are mapped into a compact set of region classes used throughout the pipeline (e.g., plots , parks , alleys , urban forest , and other vegetation-relevant categories). The layers are rasterized into aligned masks and grouped into exclusion and mandatory regions (e.g., building, road, water, pathway, open space, and grass).
blocks.zh: OSM标记被绘制成一套紧凑的区域类别,在整个管道中使用(例如地块、公园、巷道、城市森林和其他与植被有关的类别)。 层层被光栅化成相接的口罩并被划分为排斥和强制区域(如建筑、道路、水、路径、空地和草地等)。

blocks.en: We use a library of parameterized vegetation assets categorized as large trees, small trees, and shrubs. blocks.en: We generate vegetation layouts using Gemini 3 Pro ( Google DeepMind, 2025 ) on the conditioning raster, subject to spatial constraints : only pixels labeled as grass are editable. Obstacles (paths, buildings, water) and the outside-canvas background are regions where vegetation cannot be placed, and the pixels in these regions must remain unchanged. The prompt restricts the vocabulary of vegetation assets to ( largetree , smalltree , shrub ), each represented by a distinct canopy color; lawns form the editable ground region. blocks.en: The VLM output is post-processed deterministically. Each detected bounding box is first assigned to one of the vegetation classes and mapped from image coordinates to lot coordinates by T − 1 T^{-1} . The box center defines the initial 2D instance position, while the box extent defines an initial footprint that is converted into a 3D bounding ellipsoid. A placement is marked invalid if its center lies outside the editable scene region, if its ellipsoid extends outside the lot, intersects obstacle polygons, overlaps path geometry, or violates vegetation-to-vegetation collision constraints. The invalid placements are repaired in two steps. First, center reprojection moves the instance center to the nearest feasible location on the planting mask. Then, local obstacle correction shifts the bounding ellipsoid along the signed-distance gradient until remaining intersections are removed. The maximum number of repair iterations is 30. If the instance is still invalid, it is discarded. More technical details about the repair step of our method are given in the supplementary material of this paper.

blocks.en: 3.3. In-scene Rendering and Metric Computation
blocks.zh: 3.3. 现场制作和计算

blocks.en: Segmentation buffers for each scene and each selected viewpoint are rendered. We define eye-level perspective views for skyline shape assessment and a hemispherical fisheye segmentation to compute a sky view factor at all viewpoints generated in the previous stage. The buffers are inputs to the view-dependent aesthetic metrics. We also compute the scene’s biomass based on the biomass of the vegetation assets. Furthermore, we simulate shading and acoustic exposure from the vegetation meshes. These functional terms are efficient scene-design surrogates rather than calibrated physical predictions.
blocks.zh: 每个场景和每个所选角度的分块缓冲器都会被渲染出. 我们界定了天线形状评估的眼平面视角和半球鱼眼分层,以计算前一阶段产生的所有视点的天平面系数。 缓冲器是对以取景为依托的美学度量衡的投入. 我们还根据植被资产的生物量计算现场生物量。 此外,我们模拟植被层的阴影和相声照射。 这些功能名词是高效的场景设计取而代之,而不是被校正的物理预测.

blocks.en: Shade calculation. The path-level direct-sun shading is estimated using a deterministic shadow propagation method from ( Palubicki et al., 2009 ) . Monte-Carlo or global-illumination-style estimators are substantially more expensive, while voxel shadow propagation provides a plausible approximation proxy of local light conditions ( Nauber and Mäder, 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 阴影计算。 径向直阳光阴影使用确定性阴影传播方法估算(Palubicki等人,2009年)。 Monte-Carlo或全球一闪即出式估计器的价格要高得多,而Voxel 阴影传播则提供了当地光条件的近似值(Nauber和Mäder,2024年)。

blocks.en: Acoustic exposure is estimated with a two-stage model designed for repeated evaluation during optimization. First, we pre-compute a small set of acoustic descriptors for each vegetation asset from its 3D geometry and acoustic damping value using Monte Carlo ray tracing. Second, we use the descriptors to parameterize a diffusion-with-decay simulation of sound energy on a 3D voxel grid. The resulting exposure is measured at camera view points.
blocks.zh: 声波暴露用两个阶段模型进行估计,设计在优化期间重复评价。 首先,我们使用蒙特卡洛射线追踪方法,从3D几何和相声坝值中预先计算出每组植被资产中一小组相声描述符。 其次,我们用描述符来参数化一个3D voxel网格上声能的扩散-去除模拟. 由此产生的接触在相机视点进行测量。

We trace 20,000 rays for each of 16 incident directions sampled over a hemisphere per vegetation asset in a pre-processing stage. Each ray performs a single interaction with the geometry. At the intersection point, the outgoing direction is sampled either as a specular or a diffuse reflection, where diffuse directions are sampled from a cosine-weighted lobe. We compute three parameters per asset from the final distribution of outgoing ray directions and energies: (1) s rand s_{\mathrm{rand}} is the fraction of reflected energy describing random scattering (using ISO-17497-1), (2) d n d_{n} denotes a normalized measure of how spread-out the outgoing energy is over the azimuth, where higher values imply stronger spreading (using ISO-17497-2), and (3) 𝝁 \boldsymbol{\mu} is the dominant outgoing direction. For reflected rays with outgoing unit directions 𝝎 i \boldsymbol{\omega}_{i} and remaining energies w i w_{i} , we define 𝝁 = ∑ i w i ​ 𝝎 i / ‖ ∑ i w i ​ 𝝎 i ‖ \boldsymbol{\mu}=\sum_{i}w_{i}\boldsymbol{\omega}_{i}/\|\sum_{i}w_{i}\boldsymbol{\omega}_{i}\| ,

blocks.en: Our main goal is to generate optimal green layouts through non-convex optimization. Therefore, we process the 3D representation of our generated park output through a shade and acoustic exposure simulation pipeline, and compute all relevant skyline and biomass metrics. We then start the final optimization stage of our framework, leveraging CMA-ES. For a selected set of M M CMA-ES scene operators, (4) θ = { ( s i x ​ y , s i z , 𝐳 i ′ ) } i = 1 M , \theta=\{(s_{i}^{xy},s_{i}^{z},\mathbf{z}^{\prime}_{i})\}_{i=1}^{M}, where ( s i x ​ y , s i z ) (s_{i}^{xy},s_{i}^{z}) are horizontal and vertical scale multipliers and 𝐳 i ′ ∈ ℝ 6 \mathbf{z}^{\prime}_{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{6} is an attribute proposal in the asset space of Eq. ( 1 ). All feasible instances of the repaired configuration are optimized: the VLM proposal fixes the number, class, and 2D position of the instances; the repair operator (Sec. 3.2 ) runs once before optimization to establish feasibility; and CMA-ES subsequently adjusts only the per-instance scales and attribute proposals, with the GMM assignment triggering discrete species substitutions. blocks.en: In this section, we present the results of our modeling framework.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们介绍了我们的建模框架的结果。

blocks.en: Figure 14 shows three design concepts: formal (geometric or axial), picturesque (English landscape), and modernist. They are commonly treated as distinct and iconic historical styles in landscape design and landscape architecture ( Rogers, 2001 ) . To quantify the design principles, we propose orientation entropy and linearity: formal layouts tend to have lower entropy and higher linearity, while picturesque layouts are more irregular.
blocks.zh: 图14显示了三种设计概念:正文(几何或轴),相克(英语地貌)和现代主义. 在景观设计和地貌建筑中,它们被普遍视为独特和标志性的历史风格(Rogers,2001.). 为了量化设计原理,我们提出取向py和线性:正版布局往往具有更低的 en和更高的线性,而相片克布局则更不规则.

blocks.en: We embed each scene from its GeoJSON vegetation layout (tree and shrub point locations) by computing two deterministic layout descriptors in a common metric frame (EPSG:3857): orientation entropy is the Shannon entropy of a 36-bin histogram of nearest-neighbor bearing angles modulo 180 ∘ 180^{\circ} (low for axis-aligned grids; high for irregular and circulinear layouts), while linearity is the fraction of points whose two nearest neighbors are approximately collinear (within 5 ∘ 5^{\circ} ), reported as a percentage. We plot 33 reconstructed reference parks with known design strategies and 30 generated parks from three OSM sites and style-specific prompts (three templates per style, with LLM-generated textual variants); the generated parks are rendered as circles. The clusterings show that the two descriptors separate the three strategies and that prompt-conditioned generations align with the corresponding reference distributions, supporting both metric validity and reproducible style control from the GeoJSON layouts.

blocks.en: Figure 11 shows results with our 3D generative pipeline from a single OSM input, but different text prompts. We use the parcel boundary and OSM-derived path network of St. Mary’s Park and reconstruct a reference vegetation layout from the NYC Tree Map inventory (geolocated trees with species and size attributes) ( NYC Parks, 2024 ) . Starting from the single OSM masks, we vary only the text prompt (e.g., agroecological , East Asian , infrastructural , post-modernist , formal , picturesque , modernist , memorial ), yielding diverse 3D layouts that appear as plausible design alternatives to the reconstructed St. Mary’s Park baseline (top left panel in Figure 11 ). The results show generated complex vegetation layouts; e.g., the agroecological layout features haphazardly distributed trees and bushes, whereas the modernist and memorial layouts are sparser and more organized.

blocks.en: Figure 12 shows an objective-ablation study on Joyce Kilmer Park. Panel (a) shows the reconstructed reference layout from the NYC tree inventory (3D trees placed at their real locations), used as the input condition. Panels (b–f) show five optimization configurations in which one objective term is assigned a dominant weight while the remaining terms are assigned low or zero weights. This protocol isolates the qualitative effect of each criterion while keeping the site boundary, path network, feasibility constraints, asset library, and optimizer fixed. A key observation is that CMA-ES can substantially change the perceived park design without changing the underlying planting positions. Most of the visible differences arise from continuous rescaling and GMM-driven discrete substitutions (crown width, height propensity, and species-level density proxies). The skyline-targeted run (b) exhibits a distinct, non-local signature: alternating canopy heights emerge along the view direction to match a periodic skyline profile. Increasing SVF (c) results in species with tall or wide crowns being replaced by slimmer forms so that the same spatial arrangement gives the impression of a more open, plaza-like room from interior viewpoints. Minimizing shade (d) selects narrower, more open crowns and lower effective canopy density. The noise-reduction target in (e) yields a belt-like planting appearance by selecting species with higher attenuation for regions near the viewpoints. Finally, maximizing biomass (f) increases visual mass by selecting broader-canopy assets and higher scale factors, yielding a denser canopy and reduced long-range sightlines. The exact weights and targets for each experiment are listed in the supplementary material and released with the code.
blocks.zh: 图12显示了乔伊斯·基尔默公园的客观研究. 小组(a) 显示从纽约市树木库存(3D棵树放在其真实位置)中重建的参考布局,用作输入条件。 面板(b-f)显示5个优化配置,其中一个客观名词被指定为主重,而其余名词被指定为低重或零重. 此协议隔离了每个标准的质量效果,同时保持了站点边界,路径网络,可行性限制,资产库和优化器的固定. 一项关键的意见是,CMA-ES可以大幅度地改变所感知的公园设计,而不改变基本的种植位置. 可见的差异大多出自于连续的缩放和GMM驱动的离散替代(克龙宽度,高度倾向和物种级密度代位). 以天线为目标的跑 (b) 显示一个明显的非局部的签名:在取景方向上出现交替的花冠高地来匹配定期的天线描述. 增加的SVF(c)导致高冠或宽冠的物种被更瘦的形态所取代,从而使同样的空间安排给人一种印象,即从内部角度来说,是一个更开放的,类似于广场的房间. 将阴影最小化 (d) 选择更窄,更开放的花冠和更低的有效花冠密度. (e)中的降噪目标通过为近视区域选择具有较高减弱度的物种,产生类似带状种植的外观。 最后,将生物量最大化(f)通过选择更宽的冠状资产和更大规模的因素来增加视觉质量,产生更密集的冠状物并减少远距离视线。 每个实验的具体重量和目标在补充材料中列出,并随代码一起发布.

blocks.en: Figure 11 provides a qualitative SOTA comparison to Figure 6 in the procedural urban-forestry method of Niese et al. (2022) . Their method defines representative procedural planting strategies, including semi-random, boundary-biased, and clustered placement. Our prompt-conditioned pipeline qualitatively reproduces these baseline planting patterns.

blocks.en: Figure 13 demonstrates this capability on multiple reconstructed site lots derived from OSM. For each example, we use the OSM parcel boundary and building footprint polygons, extrude the footprints into 3D building masses (blue), and treat these as exclusion constraints for vegetation placement. Despite substantial variation in parcel shape, footprint size, and building placement, the generated layouts remain constraint-adherent and adapt the planting structure to the remaining ground area: vegetation concentrates along parcel edges and setbacks, fills residual wedges and corners, and forms strip-like bands where the geometry induces narrow corridors.
blocks.zh: 图13显示了从OSM获得的多块重建后场地的这种能力。 例如,我们使用OSM地块的分界线和建立脚印多边形,将脚印挤入3D建筑群(蓝色),并将这些作为植被布局的排斥限制。 尽管在地块形状、足迹大小和建筑物布局方面有很大差异,但所生成的布局仍然具有制约性,并使种植结构适应所剩地块:沿地块边缘和后退地块的植被集聚地,填满了残存的楔形和角,并在几何诱发狭窄走廊的地方形成条状带.

blocks.en: Table 1 summarizes N = 30 N=30 independent runs with independently sampled VLM layouts (the VLM API is unseeded; downstream stages use fixed seeds) and reports absolute deviations from the optimization targets. The reconstructed park layout yields a high total cost and fails to meet several prompt-specific objectives, such as SVF and Acoustics. The VLM prior exhibits substantial sample sensitivity, with large run-to-run variance in several terms (e.g. skyline-related error), whereas the CMA-ES refinement consistently reduces both the mean target error and the variance across runs, indicating that the optimization stage significantly improves objective alignment over the VLM prior.

blocks.en: To isolate the role of the VLM prior, we additionally perform a component ablation on Joyce Kilmer Park (Table 2 ). We compare random-position initialization, random initialization followed by CMA-ES, the VLM-derived prior, and the final VLM-initialized CMA-ES result. The VLM prior already improves shade scores over random placement while keeping biomass in a comparable range, indicating that the prompt-conditioned layout provides a useful semantic initialization rather than only random feasible samples. Starting from random placement, CMA-ES improves the functional scores, but remains less effective than VLM-initialized CMA-ES because random layouts often place vegetation away from paths. The final VLM+CMA-ES result achieves the highest shade and acoustic scores while minimizing biomass.
blocks.zh: 为了将VLM之前的角色隔离开来,我们额外在乔伊斯·基尔默公园(表2)上执行一个组件减缩. 我们比较随机-位置初始化,随机-初始化之后的CMA-ES,VLM出自前作,最后的VLM出自CMA-ES初始化的结果. VLM 先前已经改进了阴影分数而不是随机放置,同时将生物质保持在可比较的范围内,表明即时条件布局提供了有用的语义初始化,而不仅仅是随机可行的样本. 从随机放置开始,CMA-ES可以改进功能分数,但依然不如VLM-初始化的CMA-ES有效,因为随机布局往往将植被远离路径. 最终的VLM+CMA-ES结果在将生物质量降到最低的同时,实现了最高的遮荫分和声分分分.

blocks.en: 5. Discussion and Limitations

blocks.en: Generating plausible vegetation placements in urban scenes is challenging because solutions must simultaneously satisfy geometric constraints and align with human expectations for planting structure and landscape style. Prior work tends to restrict the design space; for example, Niese et al. (2022) focuses primarily on trees and does not model understory vegetation, nor does it explicitly couple functional performance with perceptual architectural strategies; in contrast, our method configures heterogeneous multi-class plantings under such coupled objectives.
blocks.zh: 在城市场景中产生可行的植被布局具有挑战性,因为解决办法必须同时满足几何限制,并符合人类对种植结构和景观风格的期望。 先前的工作倾向于限制设计空间;例如,Niese等人. 2022年(2022年)主要注重于树木,不以底生植被为模型,也不明确将功能性能与感知性建筑策略相配合;相形之下,我们的方法在这种相通的目标下配置了多种多样的多类栽培.

blocks.en:
A core bottleneck is that many landscape-architectural principles are qualitative and therefore difficult to formalize in a procedural manner. Our pipeline separates responsibilities accordingly: the constrained image-edit prior provides stylistically coherent, human-plausible structure, while CMA-ES operates on a low-dimensional 3D parameterization to optimize scene-derived objectives via statistical evaluation of in-scene renderings and physics-inspired surrogate metrics. However, this gain in expressive power of scene modeling comes at the cost of algorithm runtime.
Another limitation is that our functional metrics are designed as optimization surrogates, approximative in nature, rather than first-principles-based physical simulations. Finally, our method has a slower runtime than procedural urban vegetation configuration approaches, which report placing 50K trees per minute ( ( Niese et al., 2022 ) ) but do not optimize for functional or aesthetic objectives.
blocks.zh:
一个核心瓶颈是,许多地貌建筑原则是定性的,因此难以以程序方式正式化。 因此,我们的管道将责任分开:受限的图像编辑先提供有条理的连贯的、人性的、可信的结构,而CMA-ES则在低维的3D参数化上运作,通过对场景渲染和物理启发的替代度量的统计评价来优化场景衍生目标。 然而,场景建模的这种表现力增益是以算法运行时间为代价.
另一个局限是,我们的功能度量被设计为优化代用,在性质上相近,而不是以第一原理为基础的物理模拟. 最后,我们的方法运行时间比程序化的城市植被配置方法要慢,它们报告每分钟放出5万棵树(Niese等人,2022年),但没有优化功能或美学目标.

blocks.en: 6. Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6. 国家 结论

blocks.en: We introduced a pipeline for urban vegetation design that combines a constrained image-edit generative prior with a low-dimensional, simulation-driven CMA-ES refinement loop. The generative stage produces stylistically coherent top-down layouts that capture perceptual landscape strategies, while the optimization stage improves functional and view-dependent objectives by performing continuous scale adjustments and discrete asset substitutions within an attribute-space GMM. Our results show prompt-conditioned controllability, metric-consistent clustering with reconstructed exemplars of known styles, and substantial refinement gains beyond the generative prior, suggesting a practical route to integrate high-level aesthetic intent with surrogate-based performance criteria in automated park design.
blocks.zh: 我们为城市植被设计引入了一条管道,它结合了在低维、模拟驱动的CMA-ES精密循环之前的受限图像编辑基因。 基因相位阶段产生有条理的自上而下一致的布局来捕捉感知地貌策略,而优化相位阶段则通过在一个属性-空间GMM内进行连续的尺度调整和离散的资产替代来改进功能和取景目标. 我们的结果显示了快速有条件的可控性,与被重建的已知风格实例相符合的量子组合,以及超越基因前的大幅完善收益,建议在自动化公园设计中将高水平审美意图与取而代之性能标准相融合的实用途径.

blocks.en: This supplementary material provides implementation and reproducibility details for the GreenScapes pipeline. The main paper describes the complete method: an OSM-derived site representation is converted into a top-down conditioning image; a VLM produces a semantic vegetation-layout prior; detected instances are projected into a metric 3D scene and repaired if needed; and CMA-ES refines the resulting configuration under perceptual and functional objectives. This document provides the VLM protocol, deterministic post-processing and repair rules, CMA-ES settings, objective configurations, optimization traces, and acoustic-exposure parameters used in the reported experiments. All settings reported here correspond to the released implementation (Sec. 9 ).
blocks.zh: 这一补充材料为GreenScapes管道提供了实施和可复制的细节。 主要论文描述了整个方法:从OSM衍生出的一个站点代表被转换成自上而下调的图像;VLM产生一个语义植被铺放前;检测出的例子被预测成一个公制的三维场景并在需要时进行修复;CMA-ES在知觉和功能目标下完善了由此产生的配置. 该文件提供了VLM协议,定型后处理和维修规则,CMA-ES设置,客观配置,优化痕迹,以及报告实验中使用的声波曝光参数. 这里报告的所有设置都对应已发布的执行(第9节).

blocks.en: 2.1. Model and API settings

blocks.en: All reported VLM layout-generation experiments use the Google Gemini API model string gemini-3-pro-image-preview . We refer to this model as the Gemini 3 Pro image preview in the paper. The image-editing stage uses a fixed prompt template and a site-specific conditioning image. Unless stated otherwise, the generated image resolution is 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 with aspect ratio 1 : 1 1{:}1 . Each prompt produces one accepted image; failed API calls are retried up to five times using the same prompt and input image. The object-annotation pass uses the same model string and a fixed JSON/bounding-box instruction. For the JSON box-annotation call, the temperature is set to 0.5 0.5 ; the dot-annotation variant used for the city-scale examples uses the API’s default sampling parameters. The image-generation call uses the API’s image-generation defaults for sampling parameters that are not explicitly exposed in our scripts. Note that the Gemini image-generation API does not expose a random seed; VLM samples are therefore stochastic, and all reported robustness statistics are computed over independently sampled layouts. All downstream pipeline stages use fixed seeds.

blocks.en: The VLM annotation pass converts the generated top-down image into a list of object boxes. Each returned object is required to use one of the three vegetation labels used by the downstream pipeline. blocks.en: 3. Projection, Feasibility Checks, and Repair
blocks.zh: 3. 预测、可行性检查和修理

blocks.en: Each VLM bounding box is assigned to a vegetation class and mapped from image coordinates to lot coordinates using the inverse affine transform T − 1 T^{-1} defined by the top-down rasterization. The box center defines the initial 2D instance position, and the box extent defines the initial footprint used to instantiate a 3D bounding ellipsoid. Feasibility tests operate on the 2D footprint disc of each instance (the equatorial cross-section of its bounding ellipsoid); vertical extents are assigned from class- and asset-specific priors. The instance is invalid if its center lies outside the editable planting mask, if its footprint extends outside the lot, if it intersects obstacle polygons, if it overlaps path geometry, or if it violates vegetation–vegetation collision constraints.
blocks.zh: 每个VLM边框被分配到植被类别,并使用由自上而下光栅化定义的反向芳香变换T− 1 T^{-1}从图像坐标被映射到批量坐标. 框中心定义了初始的2D实例位置,而框范围则定义了用于即时化3D绑定椭圆的初始脚印. 对每个实例的2D足迹盘(其边界椭圆的赤道横截面)进行可行性测试;从特定类别和具体资产前科中划出纵向范围。 如果其中心位于可编辑的植入口罩之外,如果其足迹延伸出地块之外,如果其交叉障碍多边形,如果其与路径几何相重叠,或者违反植被-植被相撞限制,则该实例无效.

blocks.en: Invalid instances are repaired by a deterministic two-stage operator. First, center reprojection moves the center to the nearest feasible location on the planting mask. Nearest feasible location is measured by Euclidean distance in the metric lot coordinate frame. Second, obstacle correction shifts the footprint locally along the signed-distance gradient to remove remaining intersections. The maximum number of repair iterations is 30. If the instance is still invalid after 30 iterations, it is discarded. Discarded instances are not counted in reported vegetation-instance counts, biomass calculations, optimization variables, or validation statistics. The repair operator runs once, before optimization; during CMA-ES refinement, feasibility is maintained by clamping the scale parameters to their bounds (Sec. 4 ).

blocks.en: Figure 1 plots the CMA-ES optimization trace for Joyce Kilmer Park as normalized target error (0 = at target, 1 = worst). Starting from the VLM-initialized scene at generation 0, CMA-ES rapidly decreases most errors within the first ∼ 10 \sim 10 generations. After this initial drop, the curves enter a slower refinement regime where improvements become incremental and occasionally non-monotonic, most visibly for shade and biomass, reflecting trade-offs introduced by discrete asset substitutions and constraint repairs. By the end of the run ( ∼ 30 \sim 30 generations), SVF, skyline fit, shade, and biomass converge to low residual error, while noise reduction remains higher, indicating that the acoustic objective is harder to satisfy simultaneously under the same geometric constraints.

blocks.en: Acoustic exposure is evaluated with a two-stage surrogate model designed for repeated use inside CMA-ES. In preprocessing, each vegetation asset is assigned three geometric-acoustic descriptors computed from its 3D geometry. We trace 20,000 single-bounce Monte Carlo rays for each of 16 incident directions per asset (RNG seed 12). Incident directions are sampled over a hemisphere using cosine-weighted sampling. At the first intersection, the outgoing direction is sampled as either specular or diffuse reflection, with diffuse directions drawn from a cosine-weighted lobe. From the resulting outgoing-direction distribution we compute a random-scattering fraction s rand s_{\mathrm{rand}} , a normalized angular-spread descriptor d n ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] d_{n}\in[0,1] , and a mean outgoing direction 𝝁 \boldsymbol{\mu} .

blocks.en: 8. Notes on Reported Counts and Statistics
blocks.zh: 8. 关于已报告的计算和统计的说明

blocks.en: All reported instance counts are computed after VLM annotation, metric reprojection, feasibility checking, and repair. Instances discarded after failed repair are excluded. This convention is used consistently for the large-scale examples, biomass calculations, optimizer variable construction, and validation statistics. The convention avoids counting objects that were proposed by the VLM but could not be placed in the valid metric scene.
blocks.zh: 所有报告的实例数都是在VLM注释、度量再预测、可行性检查和修复之后计算的。 修复失败后丢弃的情况不在此列。 这一公约一贯用于大规模实例、生物量计算、优化可变结构以及验证统计。 公约避免了对由VLM提出但无法放置在有效度量场景中的物体进行计数.

blocks.en: Across 147 park-generation experiments, the VLM-derived initial layout contained at least one invalid placement in 48 cases. Such invalid placements were corrected by the deterministic repair stage when possible; otherwise, the offending instances were discarded and excluded from downstream counts. In all 147 experiments, the optimization stage modified the VLM-derived scene through feasible configuration changes, scale adjustment, or asset/species substitution. This supports the interpretation of the VLM as a semantic prior rather than as the final layout generator.
blocks.zh: 在147个园地发电实验中,从VLM衍生的初始布局中至少有48个案例的放置无效。 这种无效的安置在可能时通过确定性修理阶段加以纠正;否则,违规的情况就被抛弃,排除在下游计数之外。 在所有147个实验中,优化阶段通过可行的配置变化,尺度调整,或资产/物种替代,修改了VLM衍生场景. 这支持将VLM解释为语义上先发而后发的排版生成器.

blocks.en: 9. Code and Data Release
blocks.zh: 9. 国家 代码和数据发布

blocks.en: We release the implementation of the GreenScapes pipeline at https://github.com/greenscapes-project/greenscapes . The release comprises the optimization engine (Rust), the VLM pipeline and acoustic surrogate (Python), all VLM prompt templates and arrangement-rule blocks, the object- and viewpoint-annotation prompts, the projection and repair operators, the objective definitions and per-experiment optimizer configurations, the species database with the complete GMM parameters ( data/species/species.json ), the acoustic descriptor precomputation and diffusion solver, analysis tooling (style metrics, optimization traces, attribute-space visualization), site data for the reported examples, and automated tests, including the acoustic tree-belt validation. Because the commercial 3D vegetation assets used for the paper’s renderings cannot be redistributed, the release includes a script that generates placeholder assets with identical bounding volumes, so quantitative results reproduce while renderings appear schematic. Because VLM APIs may change over time, the release records the exact model string ( gemini-3-pro-image-preview ), prompt instances, image resolution, and post-processing rules used for the reported experiments; the image-generation API exposes no random seed, so VLM outputs are stochastic.
blocks.zh: 在https://github.com/greenscapes-project/greenscapes上,我们发布了绿色卡普斯管道的实施。 发布内容包括:优化引擎(Rust),VLM管道和声学代词(Python),所有VLM的即时模板和安排规则块,对象和视角注释提示符,投影和修复操作器,客观定义和每个实验优化配置,具有完整的GMM参数(数据/物种/物种.json)的物种数据库,声学分解预分解和扩散解析器,分析工具(样式度量,优化痕迹,属性-空间可视化),报告实例的站点数据,以及自动测试,包括声学树带验证. 由于用于纸质渲染的商业三维植被资产无法再分配,因此发行时包含一个脚本,生成具有等同边界量的占地资产,因此定量结果在渲染出现图示时再现. 因为VLM API可能会随时间而变化,发布会记录准确的模型字符串(gemini-3-pro-image-preview),即时实例,图像分辨率,以及用于被报道的实验的后处理规则;图像生成API会暴露出没有随机种子,因此VLM输出具有斯多克性.
